info.title: Signal IQ API
info.description:
# Signal IQ report APIs

Use these APIs to fetch Signal IQ reports after a flow reaches a successful terminal status and you have a `reportId`.

## Authentication

All endpoints require:

- `x-client-id`
- `x-client-secret`
- `x-product-instance-id`

## Available APIs

- **Setu JSON** — `GET /v1/insights/{reportId}`
- **Setu Excel** — `GET /v1/insights/excel/{reportId}`
